jobs_results.title: Desarrolladores ruby on rails
jobs_results.description:
¿Te interesaría formar parte de una de las start-ups más prometedoras de Barcelona, en el sector de la hostelería? ¿No cuentas con permiso de trabajo en Europa, sin embargo, estás abierto a mudarte a Barcelona, una de las ciudades más multiculturales del mundo? ¡Entonces este podría ser la oportunidad que estabas buscando!

En Oxigent Technologies, consultora francesa y de espíritu joven, seleccionamos a desarrolladores de Ruby on Rails para que se unan a un equipo técnico para diseñar e implementar productos de software, con la finalidad de ofrecer una experiencia única a sus usuarios.
Te unirás al equipo de TI y tu misión principal será mejorar y ampliar la plataforma de software de nuestros clientes y ayudarlos a diseñar y construir una nueva generación de plataformas de software.

¿Cuáles serán sus funciones?
- Desarrollo de producto en Ruby/Rails de un producto web relacionado con la hostelería.
- Integraciones entre nuestra plataforma y API de terceros.
- Trabajar en un entorno... ágil con gran atención a la escalabilidad (atendemos a cientos de miles de visitantes únicos por mes a través de nuestro CMS).
- Discutir, cuestionar, desafiar y ofrecer soluciones técnicas a las necesidades del producto junto con los equipos de producto y diseño.
- Identificar cuellos de botella, bugs y proponer soluciones.

Para ello solicitamos los siguientes requisitos:
- Experiencia relevante en desarrollo web.
- Más de 3 años de experiencia en Ruby.
- Pragmatismo y obsesión por la sencillez, la eficiencia y el rendimiento.
- Conocimiento comprobado de programación orientada a objetos, bases de datos, desarrollo y metodologías de prueba.
- Obsesión por la calidad y las pruebas.
- Uso avanzado del idioma inglés (hablado y escrito).
Deseable:
- Experiencia con tecnologías front-end (es decir, JavaScript o React es una gran ventaja).
- Experiencia con pruebas unitarias o ganas de aprender nuevas tecnologías y/o frameworks, como por ejemplo RSPEC).
¿Qué necesitamos?
- Contrato indefinido por Oxigent Technologies.
- Salario acorde a la experiencia brindada
- Posición 100% remota, aunque implica que el consultor esté dispuesto a residir en Barcelona y/o alrededores.
- Compensación flexible, que se aplica a seguros médicos privados, tickets restaurante, tarjeta de transporte, guardería y formación.
- Cheque de formación escalable año a año.
- Andjoy (aplicación de acceso al gimnasio).

Importante: Ofrecemos patrocinio de visa para este puesto. Sin embargo, los candidatos potenciales deben comprometerse a ser reubicados en Barcelona tan pronto como las autoridades de inmigración españolas aprueben los documentos respectivos

jobs_results.description:
¿Quieres formar parte del #TeamPanel? Ampliamos nuestro equipo y nos gustaría contar contigo para formar parte de un proyecto en el que estamos trabajando integrados en cliente.

Requisitos de la oferta...
Programador Ruby on Rails 2 años experiencia
Conocimientos y experiencia en desarrollo de aplicaciones Ruby on Rails JQuery, bootstrap, AJAX y nociones en coffescript.
Despliegues con Capistrano, servidores unicorn, arquitectura DAO y MVC aplicada en Ruby
Pruebas unitarias con RSPEC
Gestión de usuarios con Devise e implementación de gemas y configuración.

¿De qué estarás a cargo?
Formarás parte del equipo de desarrollo para uno de los grandes proyectos en los que trabajamos, de la mano con uno de nuestros grandes clientes.

Lugar de trabajo:
Remoto

¿Qué ofrecemos?
-Impulsaremos tu Talento con un Plan de Desarrollo Profesional y Programas de Tutoría individualizada.
-Completo Programa de formación que incluye desde programas de especialización técnica hasta idiomas, habilidades en... gestión de proyectos, metodologías ágiles y certificaciones. Tanto on-line como presencial.
-Políticas de conciliación como el Teletrabajo en modo full-remote; jornada continua los viernes y en verano, flexibilidad horaria, días de permiso en navidad, y facilidades para la movilidad geográfica de los empleados.
-Beneficios sociales como retribución flexible, complemento al 100% de bajas médicas, condiciones especiales en seguro médico privado o Tarjeta VISA empleados.

Nuestra empresa es hoy referencia en el sector del Software Quality Assurance, participando en varios proyectos de investigación a nivel europeo, y con muchos más proyectos sobre los que podrás diseñar una trayectoria profesional a largo plazo. Aplica y nos conoceremos

jobs_results.title: Ruby On Rails Developer
jobs_results.description:
🛫 WHO ARE WE ? 🛫

FCM Travel is one of the largest and fastest-growing global business travel management companies with a worldwide reach in almost 100 countries. FCM Lab in Barcelona represents a tribe of more than 110 teammates, united by a single mission: developing and ensuring the best services and technology products to support business travellers in their trips around the globe.

See our video (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=azjVTDV0m94) to discover who we are or read more about us at www.fcmtravel.com.

🚀 THE JOB

As a Ruby On Rails Developer, you will create and develop new products for FCM as well as our internal clients.

You will also help to develop or maintain our existing products :
• A tool for travel proposals
• A CRM
• A tool for data analysis
• Some others projects

All of them used across Europe and the world!

🎯 OUR TECHNOLOGY

We work with SCRUM methodology and Agile approach. We like Unit testing, Code Reviews, CI/CD and Cloud.

Our current technology stack... is:
• Back End : Ruby on Rails (mainly Rails 7.X)
• Frond End : mainly ReactJS
• Databases : PostgreSQL and some MongoDB, we also have a couple of MySQL and Redis
• Development & production : Kubernetes, Docker, GitLab, Digital Ocean
• Event sourcing : Apache Kafka

👀 Our Ideal Candidate ?
• 3 years or more of experience in developing projects with Ruby
• Experience with APIs of different kind
• You are comfortable to work in an international team, in English
• You know how to be both a team player and self-reliant!

🎁 WHY FCM SPAIN ?

As well as being a fun company to work :
• We offer our team the choice between working 100% Remote, or in hybrid in a great location in the center of Barcelona
• You have the opportunity to join our free language lessons (English, French, Spanish or Catalan) and some hours for training and self-grow per sprint
• An attractive package: health insurance & tickets to conferences
• 25 days off/year + 5 compensation days + reduced time during summer + bank holidays
• Flexible working-time
• Table tennis on the terrace, a kitchen area with free snacks, fresh fruits and drinks
• The opportunity to work with an international and talented team
• Several activities organised by the ambassadors!

We truly think your personality is important, so bring it on!

🖇️Contract type : Indefinite contract

🗓️ Starting date : As soon as possible

📌 Location : Plaza Catalunya, Barcelona

jobs_results.title: Senior Rails Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
About the job

We’re looking for a senior software engineer to join our tiny (but powerful 💪) remote team on our mission to build the best stock analysis platform for everyday investors.

You will implement product features using Ruby on Rails in the backend and React on the frontend.

About Us

WallStreetZen is a web app that makes it easier for everyday investors to research and understand stocks.

Most stock research platforms are not designed for the everyday investor.

These tools were built by finance professionals for finance professionals. Finance pros are used to scanning dense tables filled with ratios and comparing the numbers in their head or in complex Excel models.

But why should non-pros analyze stocks with the same tools? We focus on making financial data easy to understand, by simplifying it and putting it into easy-to-understand context.

You can try it for yourself at WallStreetZen.com

Why join us?
• 🧑🤝🧑 Work with a small, high-impact team that moves quickly... No bureaucracy.
• 🌎 Work remotely
• 🚀 We’re self-funded and profitable, with room to grow
• 🏟 Nearly half a million people interact with our web app every month
• 🛠️ You get to build interesting stock analysis tools for everyday investors

You will be responsible for working on a wide range of product and marketing features, including:
• A portfolio tracker
• Public company financial statement analysis visualizations
• A comparison tool for public company ratios and metrics
• Ensuring data accuracy and performing data transformation where necessary
• Ingesting new data sources reliably and accurately for use in new and existing features
• Marketing engineering solutions (SEO, email marketing, custom ad display solution, A/B testing, etc)

Previous experience with stock market data or data-focused platforms would be an asset.

Expectations

We deeply believe in an iterative process when building technology and as a result, we expect a tight feedback loop - frequent communication, asking questions when there are any uncertainties, pointing out tradeoffs to be made, and front footing anything unexpected are all strongly encouraged and highly valued.

The ideal candidate:
• Collaborates effectively with product, design, and engineering team members to define and refine technical requirements
• Has good taste in engineering choices, explains and makes wise tradeoffs to balance pragmatism in achieving business requirements with adhering to technical best practices
• Delivers clean, high-quality, easily readable, and maintainable code with corresponding documentation and test cases that elegantly meets the business requirements at hand
• Prefers simplicity and likes to take a lean and iterative approach to solving problems
• Loves to reflect on challenges and improve process and tooling iteratively
• Cares about solving big, systemic problems. You look beyond the surface to identify and understand root causes and seek to resolve those instead of only addressing the symptoms
• Exhibits strong attention to detail and sweats the small things
• Understands the importance of good documentation and is proactive and consistent about recording clear and useful information as well as making it readily available to other team members and external consumers

Qualifications

Requirements:
• Solid understanding of back-end and front-end technologies
• 5+ years of relevant web development experience
• 3+ years of Ruby on Rails and React experience
• Intimate familiarity with Git and GitHub best practices
• Familiarity with data analytics
• Solid grasp of the HTTP standard and RESTful design
• Solid knowledge of PostgreSQL, particularly around query optimization and performance tuning
• Deep understanding of best practices and principles behind web application security
• Advanced knowledge and firsthand experience building production web applications at scale
• Experience with automated testing, including both unit and integration tests
• Proven track record of teamwork and delivering outstanding results
• Fluent in written and verbal English language skills

Nice to Haves

Bachelor's degree in CS or related, firm understanding of data structures and algorithms.

Experience with:
• Heroku
• Redis
• Sidekiq
• Material UI
• Redux
• Docker
• Experience with fundamental analysis of stocks and reading the company’s financial statements
• Experience hiring and managing outsourced developers

Time Zone

This role will require a few overlapping working hours with our developer in Osaka(UTC+9).

WallStreetZen asks respectfully to only apply through the application form and not email/apply to them directly. Recruiters and Agencies please do not contact WallStreetZen directly

These tools were built by finance professionals for finance professionals. Finance pros are used to scanning dense tables filled with ratios and comparing the numbers in their head or in complex Excel models.

But why should non-pros analyze stocks with the same tools? We focus on making financial data easy to understand, by simplifying it and putting it into easy-to-understand context.

You can try it for yourself at WallStreetZen.com

Why join us?
• 🧑🤝🧑 Work with a small, high-impact team that moves quickly... No bureaucracy.
• 🌎 Work remotely
• 🚀 We’re self-funded and profitable, with room to grow
• 🏟 Nearly half a million people interact with our web app every month
• 🛠️ You get to build interesting stock analysis tools for everyday investors

You will be responsible for working on a wide range of product and marketing features, including:
• A portfolio tracker
• Public company financial statement analysis visualizations
• A comparison tool for public company ratios and metrics
• Ensuring data accuracy and performing data transformation where necessary
• Ingesting new data sources reliably and accurately for use in new and existing features
• Marketing engineering solutions (SEO, email marketing, custom ad display solution, A/B testing, etc)

Previous experience with stock market data or data-focused platforms would be an asset.

Expectations

We deeply believe in an iterative process when building technology and as a result, we expect a tight feedback loop - frequent communication, asking questions when there are any uncertainties, pointing out tradeoffs to be made, and front footing anything unexpected are all strongly encouraged and highly valued.

The ideal candidate:
• Collaborates effectively with product, design, and engineering team members to define and refine technical requirements
• Has good taste in engineering choices, explains and makes wise tradeoffs to balance pragmatism in achieving business requirements with adhering to technical best practices
• Delivers clean, high-quality, easily readable, and maintainable code with corresponding documentation and test cases that elegantly meets the business requirements at hand
• Prefers simplicity and likes to take a lean and iterative approach to solving problems
• Loves to reflect on challenges and improve process and tooling iteratively
• Cares about solving big, systemic problems. You look beyond the surface to identify and understand root causes and seek to resolve those instead of only addressing the symptoms
• Exhibits strong attention to detail and sweats the small things
• Understands the importance of good documentation and is proactive and consistent about recording clear and useful information as well as making it readily available to other team members and external consumers

Qualifications

Requirements:
• Solid understanding of back-end and front-end technologies
• 5+ years of relevant web development experience
• 3+ years of Ruby on Rails and React experience
• Intimate familiarity with Git and GitHub best practices
• Familiarity with data analytics
• Solid grasp of the HTTP standard and RESTful design
• Solid knowledge of PostgreSQL, particularly around query optimization and performance tuning
• Deep understanding of best practices and principles behind web application security
• Advanced knowledge and firsthand experience building production web applications at scale
• Experience with automated testing, including both unit and integration tests
• Proven track record of teamwork and delivering outstanding results
• Fluent in written and verbal English language skills

Nice to Haves

Bachelor's degree in CS or related, firm understanding of data structures and algorithms.

Experience with:
• Heroku
• Redis
• Sidekiq
• Material UI
• Redux
• Docker
• Experience with fundamental analysis of stocks and reading the company’s financial statements
• Experience hiring and managing outsourced developers

Time Zone

This role will require a few overlapping working hours with our developer in Osaka(UTC+9).

WallStreetZen asks respectfully to only apply through the application form and not email/apply to them directly. Recruiters and Agencies please do not contact WallStreetZen directly

jobs_results.title: Ruby on rails developer/senior developer
jobs_results.description:
AppDrawn are looking to recruit a software developer to join our team of developers with experience and passion in development. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced developer with a minimum of 1 years experience. You’ll be working on the full process of the projects from beginning to the end and could get involved in all of the steps of creating the apps. As a boutique web app development company, we have a clear objective: to create innovative and bespoke web apps to elevate businesses. Our primary technology stack is Ruby-on-Rails with ReactJS for web apps and ReactNative for mobile apps.

The role
We are looking for a hard-working member of our team to come on full-time in our office based in central Barcelona.

We are looking for someone who has long-term residency in Barcelona and who is fluent in English.

Essential experience
- Ruby on Rails but other related experience may be accepted
- ReactJS
- HTML/CSS/JS

Desirable skills
- Experience with: Bootstrap... ReactNative, MySQL, Docker, Git

Our ideal candidate will be:
- Honest and straight forward
- Have the ability to adapt to new challenges
- Great at problem solving

What we offer:
- Friendly and supportive team.
- Office in central Barcelona with easy access via public transport.
- Flexible holidays.

Background: AppDrawn is a small but fast-growing web and mobile application development award-winning agency with 22 years of experience. Our core focus is on business applications and bespoke platform development. We currently manage projects from our UK office, serving clients predominantly in the London area. The development team are at Barcelona office. This role would be based in Barcelona.

We have an internal deadline of Friday 3rd June 2022 but we will be interviewing before and after then and so we encourage you to apply asap if you are interested
